proposals.before: Consort Wen's elder daughter was married to Yelü Tahieli and her younger to Yelü Yudu; Fengxian then falsely accused Yudu and others of plotting to enthrone the Prince of Jin and make Tianzuo Retired Emperor.
proposals.after: Consort Wen's elder sister was married to Yelü Tahieli and her younger sister to Yelü Yudu; Fengxian then falsely accused Yudu and others of plotting to enthrone the Prince of Jin and make Tianzuo Retired Emperor.
proposals.reason: Chinese 女兄/女弟 means elder/younger sister, not daughter.

proposals.before: It happened that Consort Wen's elder daughter by marriage was wed to Yelü Tahieli and her younger to Yelü Yudu; Fengxian then falsely reported that Yudu and others plotted to enthrone the Prince of Jin and honor Tianzuo as Retired Emperor.
proposals.after: It happened that Consort Wen's elder sister was wed to Yelü Tahieli and her younger sister to Yelü Yudu; Fengxian then falsely reported that Yudu and others plotted to enthrone the Prince of Jin and honor Tianzuo as Retired Emperor.
proposals.reason: Chinese 女兄/女弟 means elder/younger sister; 'daughter by marriage' is a mistranslation.

proposals.before: Campaign General Yelü Nieli and three others who shot deer in the imperial preserve were all executed in the marketplace.
proposals.after: Campaign General Yelü Nieli and two others who shot deer in the imperial preserve were all executed in the marketplace.
proposals.reason: Chinese 耶律涅裏三人 indicates three persons total including Nieli, not Nieli plus three others.

decisions.reason: 文妃之女兄 and 女弟 are Consort Wen's elder and younger sisters, not her daughters; the proposed idiomatic correctly restores sibling kinship while leaving the rest of the sentence intact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 文妃之女兄適耶律撻曷裏，女弟適耶律余睹

decisions.reason: 女兄/女弟 means elder/younger sister; 'elder daughter by marriage' invents a daughter reading the Chinese does not support, and the proposed literal correctly names the sisters.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 文妃之女兄適耶律撻曷裏，女弟適耶律余睹

decisions.reason: 耶律涅裏三人 counts three people in total, with Nieli included; 'and three others' wrongly makes four, while 'and two others' matches the Chinese.
